title: Day 13: I Recorded the Demo and Submitted the Entry
summary: I submitted my entry after changing the pitch: not a better Git, but a coordination layer that warns agents before they overlap. After the recording, I asked agents to add planned-file warnings and a watcher, reviewed but not yet on Cloudflare.
author: Alexey Grigorev
